title: Aircall API Review 2026: Features, Limits & Alternatives
snippet:
**Aircall's** [Public API](https://developer.aircall.io/api-references/) is a REST surface served from https://api.aircall.io/v1, with a growing v2 layer for select resources. It supports both [Basic Auth and OAuth 2.0](https://developer.aircall.io/api-references#authentication), covers calls, contacts, users, teams, numbers, messaging, webhooks, conversation intelligence, and AI Voice Agent endpoints, and ships with one official SDK (a front-end CTI library).

Aircall does not publicly state which plan tiers include API access or whether API calls are metered.

| **Pricing / access** | Bundled with paid Aircall plans (Essentials at $30/user/month); specific API access tiers not publicly documented |

The API references document a [rate limiting section](https://developer.aircall.io/api-references#rate-limiting), confirming that rate limiting is enforced. But the actual thresholds (requests per second, per minute, or by plan tier) are not published. Developers should consult the [API references directly](https://developer.aircall.io/api-references#rate-limiting) or contact Aircall for current figures.

Based on the developer documentation, API key generation is available from the Company Settings page, suggesting API access is bundled with a paid Aircall subscription rather than charged separately. The Essentials plan at [$30/user/month](https://aircall.io/pricing/) (annual, 3-user minimum) lists "100+ integrations and API access" as a feature, indicating API access on all tiers.

For a developer sizing costs: the API itself does not appear to carry incremental charges, but the platform limits are plan-dependent:
- **Essentials ($30/user/month):** Up to 3 teams, call recordings stored up to 1 year, basic analytics limited to 6 months
- **Professional ($50/user/month):** Unlimited teams, unlimited call recording storage, advanced analytics and live monitoring, Power Dialer, all AI Assist features included
- **Custom (contact sales, 25-user minimum):** API developer support, SLA, SSO, Analytics+ with unlimited history
The minimum commitment is 3 users on Essentials and Professional, or 25 users on Custom. Annual plans provide [up to 25% savings](https://support.aircall.io/en-gb/articles/30599733509277) compared to monthly pricing. Aircall requires [30 days' written notice](https://support.aircall.io/hc/en-gb/articles/19179941054877-Cancelling-your-Aircall-subscription) before the contract end date to cancel; otherwise, the contract auto-renews.
